He hears the world as muffled and often misreads conversations; he speaks louder than necessary. He retired early on disability and now repairs old drum kits in his garage every weekday, listing them on a classifieds site with meticulous, honest descriptions—photos, measurements, notes on wood grain, and honest accounts of flaws.
